local.file_match.description: Discovers files on the local filesystem using glob patterns and makes them available as targets for other components.

path_targets.description: List of targets with __path__ labels pointing to files to watch

sync_period.description: How often to sync filesystem and targets

loki.source.file.description: Reads log files from the local filesystem and forwards them to other Loki components.

targets.description: List of targets to read files from

forward_to.description: List of receivers to send log entries to

tail_from_end.description: Whether to tail from the end of files on startup

encoding.description: Encoding to use when reading files

loki.write.description: Receives log entries from other Loki components and sends them over the network using the Loki logproto format.

endpoint.description: Configures a Loki server to send logs to
Configures connection to a Loki server

url.description: URL of the Loki server to send logs to

tenant_id.description: Tenant ID to use when sending logs

headers.description: Additional headers to send with requests

loki.process.description: Receives log entries from other Loki components, applies one or more processing stages, and forwards results to other Loki components.

forward_to.description: List of receivers to send processed log entries to

stage.logfmt.description: Parses logfmt-formatted log lines and extracts fields

mapping.description: Maps extracted fields to new names

stage.json.description: Parses JSON-formatted log lines and extracts fields

stage.labels.description: Updates the label set for log entries

values.description: Maps extracted fields to label names

stage.regex.description: Parses log lines using regular expressions

expression.description: Regular expression with named capture groups

prometheus.scrape.description: Configures Prometheus-compatible scraping of HTTP endpoints and forwards metrics to other Prometheus components.

forward_to.description: List of receivers to send scraped metrics to

job_name.description: Job name to add to scraped metrics

metrics_path.description: HTTP path to scrape metrics from

prometheus.remote_write.description: Receives metrics from other Prometheus components and sends them over the network via the Prometheus remote_write protocol.

endpoint.description: Configures connection to a Prometheus remote_write endpoint

headers.description: Additional headers to send with requests

write_relabel_config.description: Relabeling rules to apply before writing

discovery.kubernetes.description: Discovers scrape targets from Kubernetes API server and makes them available to other components.

role.description: Kubernetes resource type to discover (pod, service, endpoints, etc.)

namespaces.description: Configures which namespaces to discover resources in

otelcol.receiver.otlp.description: Accepts telemetry data over the network using the OTLP protocol and forwards it to other OpenTelemetry components.

output.description: Configures where to send received telemetry

otelcol.exporter.otlp.description: Receives telemetry data from other OpenTelemetry components and exports it using the OTLP protocol.

env.description: Returns the value of an environment variable

join.description: Joins array elements with a separator

format.description: Formats a string using Go-style formatting verbs

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Format string with verbs like %s, %d, etc.

forward_to.description: List of receivers to forward data to. This creates a pipeline where data flows from one component to another.

targets.description: List of targets for the component to operate on. Format depends on the component type.

labels.description: Static labels to add to all data processed by this component
